title: SPmAutoTotem
description: SPMautototem is a client-side mod for automatically equipping a totem in the offhand slot on spm.spworlds.ru, designed for player safety in dangerous situations.
body:
<details>
<summary>ru</summary>
  
## Что делает мод

- Если в левой руке пусто, автоматически ставит туда тотем
- Работает **только** на сервере `spm.spworlds.ru`
- Не активируется на других серверах и в одиночной игре

## Важно

Мод работает только на `spm.spworlds.ru`_(и spm.spworlds.org)_ и предназначен для повышения безопасности игрока именно на этом сервере.

</details>
<details> <summary>en</summary>
  
# SPMautototem
  
In dangerous situations, a single extra second can determine the outcome of a fight, survival, or a sudden attack.
SPMautototem is designed to improve safety and reduce the risk of death caused by not having a totem in the offhand in time.

## What the mod does

- If the offhand slot is empty, it automatically places a totem there
- Works only on the server `spm.spworlds.ru`
- Does not activate on other servers or in single-player mode

## For safety
This mod is created as a tool for additional player protection.
It helps respond faster to dangerous situations and reduces the chance of losing a totem or failing to equip it manually in time.

## Important
The mod works only on `spm.spworlds.ru` and is intended to enhance player safety specifically on this server.

</details>
